note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 255; the original is in English. The alate is recorded as unknown in the original, and only the soldier and the worker are described. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and discussion have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown to chocolate brown; antennae paler than the head, darker at the apex than at the base; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; labrum concolorous with the head; body and legs pale yellow to light brown. Head pilosity sparse to moderate, body pilosity dense. Body length 5.4–7.0 mm. Head capsule wide, oval, widest posteriorly, length to the mandibular base 1.45–1.79, maximum width 1.40–1.74, width at the mandibular base 0.85–1.00 mm, the width/length ratio 0.75–0.90, the ratio of the width at the mandibular base to the maximum width 0.57–0.69. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 5 shortest. Labrum ligulate, longer than wide, length 0.35–0.50, width 0.30–0.45 mm, with a row of long setae on each side. Mandibles sword-shaped, strongly incurved at the apex, longer than half the head length, length 0.85–1.0 mm, the ratio to the head length 0.53–0.62. The left mandible with a distinct tooth at about 1/3 from the distal end, the tooth distance 0.25–0.35 mm, the ratio of the tooth distance to the mandible length 0.30–0.35. The right mandible with a minute tooth slightly before the middle. Postmentum swollen, the sides strongly arched, widest at the middle, slightly longer than wide, length 0.80–1.0, maximum width 0.70–0.80 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, both the anterior and the posterior margins markedly concave, length 0.62–0.79, width 0.98–1.42 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head pale yellowish brown; antennae light brown, paler at the base; postclypeus paler than the head; body and legs yellowish white. Body length 4.4–5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, widest at the mandibular base, length to the mandibular base 1.35–1.40, maximum width 1.55–1.68 mm. Fontanelle plate translucent, forming an oval to circular spot. Antennae 18–19-segmented; with 18 segments segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, sometimes in the process of dividing, segment 4 shortest; with 19 segments segment 3 shortest, or segments 3, 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus swollen, less than half as long as wide, length 0.28–0.30, width 0.73–0.78 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.45–0.50, width 0.83–0.90 mm, the anterior margin markedly concave, the posterior margin considerably incurved.
